requirement: GST Registration Certificate
PAN Card in the name of the bidder/firm
EPF/PF Code issued by Regional Provident Fund Commissioner (EPFO)
ESIC Registration Certificate
Audited Balance Sheets for the previous 3 financial years certified by a Chartered Accountant with UDIN
Minimum average annual contractual/financial turnover certified by CA over the last 3 years
Certificate of Incorporation / Company Registration Certificate
Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA)
Valid Labour License under the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act 1970
MSME/UDYAM Registration Certificate for EMD exemption
Class III Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) for online bid signing
Power of Attorney in favour of the person authorized to sign the tender on behalf of the firm
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) via online transfer, demand draft, or bank guarantee as specified
EMD Exemption Certificate (MSME/NSIC) in lieu of EMD payment
Bank details for ECS/NEFT/RTGS payment: bank name, branch, account number, IFSC, MICR, cancelled cheque
Self-certification/undertaking regarding land border restriction (procurement from countries sharing land border with India)
Undertaking that the firm has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Government department, PSU, or Ministry
Similar past work experience: one or more completed/ongoing contracts of a specified minimum value or percentage of estimated cost
Experience of minimum 3 years in providing similar services to Central/State Government organizations or PSUs
Work completion certificates / work order copies from previous clients as proof of similar experience
Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) or Execution Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG) as a percentage of contract value post-award
Security Deposit (typically 3–10% of contract value) via deduction from bills or upfront deposit post-award
Compliance with EPF Act 1952 and payment of minimum wages as per applicable Minimum Wages Act
Compliance with all applicable labour laws including Code on Wages, Contract Labour Act, and Bonus Act
Monthly submission of UAN, ESIC number, PF contribution challans, and wage payment statements before raising bills
Labour insurance: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana, and Workmen Compensation/ESIC
Safety compliance, accident prevention measures, and acceptance of liability for accidents involving deployed labour
Compliance with MII (Make in India) declaration — local content percentage in supplied goods or services
Submission of MSE Purchase Preference documents and declaration for 15% price preference eligibility
Compliance with GeM portal terms and conditions including Reverse Auction (RA) process participation
Avoidance of sharing common IP address with the buyer or other bidders (anti-cartelization compliance)
Site inspection declaration — tenderer must physically visit the site before submitting the bid
Affidavit on stamp paper (typically Rs. 100 non-judicial stamp paper) for various declarations as required by the tender
Acceptance letter on company letterhead for timely payment of minimum wages, bonus, and statutory charges to deployed labour
Bid offer validity of 90/120/180 days from the bid submission date as specified in the tender
Techno-commercial bid (Cover-1/Cover-2) and financial/price bid (Cover-2/Cover-3) submitted separately online as per tender structure
Online payment of non-refundable tender document fee / processing fee via NEFT/RTGS/online portal
Registration on the Shramik Kalyan portal and monthly uploading of deployed labour details
Registration on the e-procurement portal of the tendering authority (IREPS, GePNIC, MPTET, etc.)
Regular monitoring of the e-procurement portal for corrigendums, addendums, or clarifications before bid opening
Geographic presence / registered or operational office in the state/region where services are to be rendered
Deployment of minimum specified number of manpower (unskilled/semi-skilled/skilled) as per tender scope
Submission of details of ongoing work orders to assess current commitments and capacity
Declaration of local content percentage in offered goods/services (0% for imported, 100% for indigenous)
Input Tax Credit (ITC) consideration — bidder must factor full ITC benefit while quoting rates
Rates quoted exclusive of GST — GST to be charged separately as applicable
Quotation/bid validity for a minimum period of 4 months from the date of submission
Penalty clause acceptance — typically 0.5% per week for delay up to a maximum of 10% of contract value
2% Income Tax (TDS) deduction from each payment bill as per applicable Income Tax provisions
Indemnity bond submission for on-account payments, advance payments, or asset repair/replacement
One-year defect liability / guarantee period post work completion — rectification at contractor's cost
Submission of hard copy of EMD bank guarantee to the tendering authority one day before bid opening
Valid Electrical License (Class A / Supervisory) issued by State/Central Government licensing authority for the required voltage level (Madhya Pradesh)
CA Certified financial details in prescribed format (Schedule/Annexure) — turnover, net worth, solvency
Submission of Annexures, Appendix, Declarations, and Proformas as prescribed in the tender document
Authorization letter for company representative to be present at the time of bid/tender opening
Schedule of Qualifying Requirements filled and submitted as per tender format
Schedule of Deviations / Departures from tender specifications filled and submitted
Contractor's details and questionnaire (Annexure/Schedule on firm background, directors, registration details)
Provision of tools, plants, instruments, and equipment (T&P) required for execution at contractor's own cost
Inspection of materials by the client's designated authority prior to use or execution
Submission of inspection results / test reports in both soft copy and hard copy post-execution
Valid 'A' Class or equivalent electrical contractor license as required by the tendering authority (Madhya Pradesh)
NSIC Registration in lieu of EMD and tender fee for eligible small-scale industries
Training completion on the e-Procurement system of the tendering portal before bid submission
Board of Resolution
